answer: The wharf counter is kept in summit and jade makes public each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That is 1021 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
